zones.description: Perimeter residential blocks with elevated inner courtyards and underground parking provide family-oriented housing while maintaining low building coverage and open visual corridors.
Residential towers concentrated near the metro bridge axis create a transit-oriented node while preserving sunlight access and river views.
Active embankment frontage with cafés, grocery stores, local retail, and leisure uses supports public life along the waterfront and pier.
Comprehensive school with outdoor sports grounds centrally located for safe pedestrian access from all residential sectors.
First kindergarten integrated into landscaped residential courtyards with protected play areas and low traffic exposure.
Second kindergarten positioned near the northern green corridor to serve families close to Kolomenskoye Park access.
Continuous waterfront park with promenades, cycling lanes, recreation lawns, ecological planting, and direct public access to the water edge and electric boat pier.
Pedestrian and cycling boulevard connecting Rechnikov Street, residential areas, and the metro bridge with integrated mobility hub and service access.

facts: Building coverage remains below 30% of the territory.
Green and open public spaces occupy more than 45% of the site.
Maximum building height does not exceed 19 floors.
The embankment remains fully accessible to the public along the backwater and Moskva River edge.
A dedicated pedestrian and cycling corridor connects the site to the Nagatinsky Zaton metro bridge.
The zoning plan includes one school, two kindergartens, grocery retail, and local commercial services.
Residential courtyards are elevated above underground parking to improve pedestrian safety and landscape continuity.
Visual corridors toward the Moskva River and Kolomenskoye Park are preserved through stepped building placement.
The waterfront park integrates with the existing high greenery network of the surrounding district.
